title: Concept: Mail sent without transport encryption (python)
description: In python, smtplib.SMTP opens a mail session that is not protected by TLS. Password-reset links and one-time codes travel in those bodies, which makes the mail path a credential path.
applicability: Notification services, password-reset flows and cron-driven reports; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Credential and reset-link interception on the mail path; MEDIUM severity.
